info.name: LJVIS — ERRU CTUD
info.description: Functional tests for the ERRU CTUD module (LJVIS2-142 lifecycle, -143 form, -144 actions/sending, -145 list). Covers permission boundaries (ctud.read / ctud.create / ctud.send), the validation matrix, append-only snapshot behaviour, the full send flow against the in-repo mock ERRU hub (Found / NotFound / Timeout / NotAvailable / transport failure), retry-from-error, and the inbound machine endpoint on ruuter-internal including replay idempotency.
